facts.text: The Panther Promise Program guarantees tuition support grants of up to $2,000 for undergraduate students with family incomes of $30,000 or less.

sources.title: Grants – Financial Aid - Prairie View A&M University
sources.quote: The PVAMU Panther Program guarantees that all participating students are provided with tuition support grants up to $2,000 for undergraduate students whose family income is $30,000 or less.
